Its a top domestic chip brand, see below weblink.

*https://www.centec.com/* <https://www.centec.com/>

Do you have a preference for the chip solution?

Thank you.

Hi, Levent,

Yes, lets think it over and make it good.

Points finalized

1, 24 port enclosure with 16 port PVC mask, the same as last order.

2, 100pcs more PVC masks

3, the same label and user manual as last order

4, provided MAC information

5, 50%-50% payment, thanks for your support btw.

6, 176 pieces(2% RMA, for the extra 74+8=82pcs, it will be on the record)



Points in discussion

1, manufacturing time: 4 weeks AFTER 50% payment

2, shipment option



Cost List

1. Unit price: 150usd(device)+1usd(console cable)=151usd/pc

5% discount and 2 free pieces(2% RMA)

That is, 151*0.95=143.45usd/pc as final unit price

2. Miscellaneous Fee

100pcs PVC mask, 2.3usd/pc, that is 230usd

Software cost deduction: 200usd

This is about 230usd-200usd=30usd

3, Total cost without shipping: 143.45*174+30usd=24990.3usd

Deposit payment: lets do 10K~12K, OK?

Btw: for the console cable cost, that is 174usd, we will try to deduct this
amount from future orders.

This is our fault, sorry again for this.



A word about shipment

1, Currently the offer is 7K usd for express(UPS)

Please first evaluate your profit and see if this is workable.

2, I will keep looking for different options(but it will be some suppliers
we do not know very well)

3, If you have a shipping agent, we can also ship it to this agent’s
warehouse.

I think there might be some local options.

Those agents handle import orders from China. In most cases, there are some
Chinese contacts who belong to the same logistics company with local agents.

Then we will be in touch with Chinese and you will be in touch with local
agents.

Lets see.

Thank you.
